description: A specialized team-and-skill pack for the plumbing trade. It bundles three things: trade how-to entries (diagnose the mechanism first, improvise tools from what's on hand, fix it right, know when to stop), career-skill entries for refining the craft (diagnose-before-you-quote discipline, flat-rate vs time-and-materials pricing, good-better-best options, running a one-truck operation, mentoring apprentices, growing to journeyman judgment), and team-play entries for how plumbing crews coordinate (two-person rough-in, emergency leak-call triage, rough-to-finish handoffs, tailgate toolbox talks, group improvisation when the parts run fails, punch-list rituals). The arc runs from foundation technique through applied repair to mastery, aimed at refining and improving the career — and ultimately feeding personal refinement tools.
name: Plumbing
